title: `getRedemptionHints` will revert if `_maxIterations` is reached
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The function `getRedemptionHints()` in `HintHelpers.sol` is used to find the right hints to pass to `redeemCollateral()`. The number of positions to consider for redemption can be capped to `_maxIterations` to avoid running out of gas.
